# Kite

> A guide dog that flies, for blind pedestrians, built at Cal Hacks 13.0. A DJI Tello flies just above and behind the walker's head and sees the route, crowds and crossings ahead; a chest camera watches the ground at their feet; AirPods deliver directional beeps (rate rises with time to contact) and Cartesia voice. Kite stops and waits rather than detouring. Safety-critical cues run in deterministic code; Claude can only make Kite more cautious.

- Voice: Cartesia Sonic (streaming TTS, ~0.1 s to first audio) and Ink (streaming STT)
- Judgment and scene description: Claude
- Shared live state across devices and the caregiver dashboard: SpacetimeDB
- Memory of personal places and hazards: Moss (3-12 ms lookups)
- Routing and nearby places: Google Routes API v2 and Places API (New)
